links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level of chatbot responses to toilet training questions
links.effect: Gemini produced a higher (more complex) Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level than ChatGPT, particularly for Questions 3 and 7. No numeric grade levels are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Regarding readability, Gemini produced responses with a higher Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level (i.e., more complex reading level), particularly for Questions 3 and 7.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the reliability and readability of consumer-facing LLM chatbots (ChatGPT-4 Turbo and Gemini 2.0 Flash) answering toilet training questions via expert rating and readability formulas without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
